title: Not useful for sports
body: The activity recording features of this app is not fit for purpose for anyone doing non-beginner sport. For example when cross country skiing, it constantly wants to pause, without you knowing unless you look at the screen. In addition the metrics it wants to show you are so irrelevant to your needs. Unless you are a beginner walker or jogger living in a warm climate, then you are better off to invest in a sports specific watch/computer.
